programs.name: ARCH National Respite Locator
programs.description: Searchable database to find local respite care providers so caregivers can take a break.

programs.name: Eldercare Locator
programs.description: Free national service that connects older adults and caregivers to local services such as home care, meals, transportation, respite, and caregiver support.
programs.eligibility: Older adults 60+ and their family caregivers

programs.name: National Family Caregiver Support Program
programs.description: Federally funded program delivered through Area Agencies on Aging providing information, respite, counseling, and training to family caregivers; access via your local agency or the Eldercare Locator.
programs.eligibility: Caregivers of adults 60+, caregivers of any-age individuals with dementia, or relatives 55+ raising children

programs.name: PACE (Program of All-Inclusive Care for the Elderly)
programs.description: Program that coordinates and pays for medical and social services so older adults needing nursing-home-level care can stay in the community, easing the caregiving load.
programs.eligibility: Adults 55+ with Medicare and/or Medicaid who need nursing-home-level care

programs.name: AARP Family Caregiving Resource Line
programs.description: Toll-free line offering information, guidance, and support for family caregivers, plus online tools and guides.
programs.eligibility: Family and informal caregivers (no membership required)

programs.name: Family Caregiver Alliance
programs.org: Family Caregiver Alliance / National Center on Caregiving
programs.description: Education, resources, and services for family caregivers, including fact sheets, care navigation, and state-by-state resource directories.

programs.name: Well Spouse Association
programs.description: Peer support for spouses and partners caring for a chronically ill or disabled loved one, including support groups and a newsletter.
programs.eligibility: Spouses and partners who are caregivers

programs.name: National Caregiver Help Desk
programs.description: Free help desk giving family caregivers personalized guidance and connections to resources.

programs.name: VA Caregiver Support Line
programs.description: Phone line staffed by licensed clinical social workers offering support, counseling, and referrals for caregivers of Veterans, and connections to local VA caregiver programs.

programs.name: 211 (United Way)
programs.description: Free 24/7 helpline connecting people to local help with bills, food, housing, and caregiving resources; call or text 211.

programs.name: 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline
programs.description: Free, confidential 24/7 crisis support by call, text, or chat for anyone in emotional distress or crisis, including overwhelmed caregivers.
programs.eligibility: Anyone in emotional distress or crisis

programs.name: Alzheimer's Association 24/7 Helpline
programs.description: Around-the-clock helpline with master's-level clinicians for dementia caregivers: information, local resources, crisis and emotional support in more than 200 languages.
programs.eligibility: Anyone affected by Alzheimer's or dementia
